description: This file contains unit tests for the ExecApprovalsGatewayPrompter component, verifying its behavior in different session matching, prompting, and fallback scenarios.

classes.name: ExecApprovalsGatewayPrompterTests
classes.description: A collection of test cases to validate the behavior of ExecApprovalsGatewayPrompter under various conditions.

methods.name: session match prefers active session
methods.description: Tests whether the prompter correctly matches an active session as active.

methods.name: session fallback uses recent activity
methods.description: Tests fallback logic when the active session is nil, based on recent activity timestamps.

methods.name: default behavior matches mode
methods.description: Verifies that the behavior of the prompt matches the specified mode (local or remote).

methods.name: askAlwaysPromptsRegardlessOfSecurity
methods.description: Ensures prompts are always shown regardless of security settings when ask is set to always.

methods.name: askOnMissPromptsOnlyForAllowlist
methods.description: Checks that prompts are shown only for allowlist security level when ask is set to onMiss.

methods.name: askOffNeverPrompts
methods.description: Verifies that no prompts are shown when ask is set to off for any security level.

methods.name: fallbackAllowlistAllowsMatchingResolvedPath
methods.description: Tests that allowlist patterns correctly allow matching of the resolved command path.

methods.name: fallbackAllowlistDeniesAllowlistMiss
methods.description: Verifies that a non-matching allowlist pattern results in denial.

methods.name: fallbackFullAllowsWhenPromptCannotBeShown
methods.description: Checks that fallback to full permission allows action when prompt cannot be shown and allowlist is empty.
